关于沿线

规划旅行时，我习惯先了解宏观历史背景，再梳理当地历史，找到与之相关的地点。我建立沿线，是为了把这些资料整理在一起，让这部分行前准备更方便、更高效。内容从欧洲开始，随着我的旅行与阅读逐步扩展。

Yuqing Ji
2026年9月26日

About Along the Way

When planning a trip, I start with the wider historical context, then explore the local history and the places connected to it. I built Along the Way to bring that research together and make this part of planning easier. It begins with Europe and grows with my travels and reading.

By Yuqing Ji
